symptom: `describe java action` always prints the placeholder body `// Java source not available from this project; body omitted by DESCRIBE.` even when javasource/<module>/actions/<Name>.java exists; re-executing the output replaces the action's code, and a rewrite drops the file's custom imports and EXTRA CODE section (Java no longer compiles when user code calls an extra-code helper, e.g. Blank template FeedbackModule.XSS_Sanitizer → sanitize())
cause: readJavaActionUserCode searched for "// begin user CODE" — mangled by the lowercase-keywords sweep (00b80f3f) — while Studio Pro writes "// BEGIN USER CODE". Separately, WriteJavaSourceFile regenerated the whole file from the statement, and MDL has no spelling for extra code
insight: A mechanical case-sweep over output keywords also rewrote string LITERALS that match file content; grep such sweeps for literals compared against external text. The loss was invisible while describe emitted plain `create` (the re-exec failed first) — fixing the verb turned a loud failure into silent code loss, so every describe-verb fix must be followed by checking what the now-succeeding exec writes OUTSIDE the unit (files on disk). Studio Pro's own banner is the retention contract: import list, user code, extra code
